term.label: RNApol_II_promoter

definition.text: A DNA sequence in eukaryotic DNA to which RNA polymerase II binds, to begin transcription.

comments: parent term RNA_polymerase_promoter SO:0001203 was obsoleted in Aug 2020, so term has been moved to eukaryotic_promoter SO:0002221.
